lines.text: Every hair on you is scheduled to fall out.
Every hair on your body is quietly keeping time.
It grows, it pauses, it rests, and then… it lets go.
On your head, growing can last for years. That's why it can grow so long.
On your eyebrow, it lasts only months. They stay short.
When growing ends, the root shrinks and the hair loosens. Then it rests for a couple months.
Meanwhile, in the same follicle, a brand new hair begins… and gently pushes the old one out.
So losing fifty to a hundred hairs a day from your head alone is normal.
Every follicle keeps its own schedule, so they never all let go at once.
Right now, you're losing hair, and growing it, at the same time.
